name: Aoyagi Yoshino
source: Mother of Miyako and wife of Iwao. She wishes for her daughter to study abroad, but finds out she has a boyfriend, Shinji. Knowing that Miyako won't leave to study because of her boyfriend, she decides to have an affair with Shinji, so he will leave Miyako and she can study abroad. [Spoiler] During the domination route Yoshino starts to feel unsatisfied with her husband and realize she is slowly falling with love with Shinji. She develop a inferiority complex towards her own daughter wanting to have Shinji all to herself. [/Spoiler]
